programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones) and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Stolen Identity
programme.desc: When a theft is committed, something valuable is stolen. But when a criminal needs a new identity, theft becomes a matter of life and death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Predators And Parasites
programme.desc: For the forensic entomologist, the insects that nest in dead bodies are like tiny witnesses to a crime.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Impressions
programme.desc: 911 receives a desperate call in Fort Worth, Texas. A man's wife is shot. Forensic investigators search for clues in unlikely places, hoping the victim herself could provide information needed to determine how and why she died.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Drawing Conclusions
programme.desc: A teenager is abducted on a shopping trip. Two hikers disappear from the Appalachian Trail.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Solving crimes may begin with gut intuition, but advanced science provides investigators with irrefutable proof. When criminals go to great lengths to mask their crimes, Investigators must step up the challenge and remain forever undaunted.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Dead Men Do Talk
programme.desc: Profiles the work of world-renowned forensic experts and the procedures they use to solve murders and other mysteries in minutes or centuries after they happen.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Cold Cases
programme.desc: These cases took a decade or more to solve. There's no statute of limitations on murder. As a case turns cold, the clues become scarce, investigators must rely on science to close cold cases.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Blood Money
programme.desc: Some people murder for love. But these killers did it for the money. When greed is the motive, investigators must make every clue pay off.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Burning Evidence
programme.desc: Identifying Burned Remains: It's difficult to have a murder investigation without a body, and burning up the victim is a time-honored method of destroying physical evidence.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Written In Blood
programme.desc: In North Carolina, the home of a prominent couple becomes an unlikely scene of terrible bloodshed. Across the country, a California woman vanishes, worrying her family and the investigators trying to find her.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Witness To Terror
programme.desc: Black Boxes: Little evidence is left after an airplane takes a deadly plunge from the sky. Investigators' best hope for an answer comes from the flight data recorder known as a black box.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Double Helix
programme.desc: DNA Analysis: With the advent of DNA analysis, just a few microscopic cells found at a crime scene can be used to put a murder behind bars.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Cold Blooded
programme.desc: Time of death is an important consideration in a murder investigation, but when a killer freezes, burns, or grinds his victim, even the most skilled medical examiner would be at a loss about how to calculate it.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Medical Examiners's Casebook
programme.desc: Some killers choose to hide their victims. And investigators must then rely on forensic examiners to uncover proof of murder. These are just two extraordinary crimes that have made their way into the medical examiner's casebook.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: When abduction turns to murder, forensic science is the only key to finding justice for the victims of a kidnapper's deadly intentions.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: The Great Outdoors may offer great clues to solving brutal murders. But it takes the keen eye of the forensic entomologist and botanist to decipher the clues nature provides.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Missing Person: Approximately 1.8 million Americans are reported missing each year. Worldwide, the number of missing persons nearly triples.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: The tread of a tire, a single shoe print and even the shape of a bruise help investigators track down killers, based solely on their patterns of guilt.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: George Orwell's concept of Big Brother remains in the realm of fiction. But as technology becomes more a part of our lives, it's becoming increasingly more difficult to make a move without leaving behind an electronic trace.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: A teenager is abducted on a shopping trip. Two hikers disappear from the Appalachian Trail.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Ballistic analysis is the key to finding killers who turn guns on their victims. Each shot fired leaves its own fingerprint, allowing scientists to target murderers with deadly aim.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: For serial killers, once is never enough. For investigators, the challenge is steep when the killers murder by numbers.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Men don't have a monopoly on murder, but it's still extraordinary when women kill. Though female killers are as deadly as males, they choose less violent methods.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Poison is an almost invisible form of death, and toxicologists must look for hidden clues in blood and tissue to bring these murders to light.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: In most homicides, police rely on motive to pursue a murderer. But when the killer is a stranger the crime may go unsolved for years. It takes a full arsenal of forensic techniques to trace a lethal encounter.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Some killers choose to hide their victims And investigators must then rely on forensic examiners to uncover proof of murder These are just two extraordinary crimes that have made their way into the medical examiner's casebook.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Photography has long been a vital tool in homicide investigations. A single image captures enough information to identify a suspect, and to preserve a vital clue long after a witness' memory fades.

programme.title: The New Detectives

programme.title: Las hermanitas Calle
programme.desc: La familia se apellida Calle. Son 4 hermanas, 1 hermano, la mamá, un tío y los novios. Dos de las hermanas son cantantes populares y consiguen un contrato discográfico, pero todos los miembros de la familia, incluyéndolas, atraviesan situaciones dramáticas. Tienen que enfrentar muchos problemas que no dejan de aparecer. Las dos protagonistas son las hermanas cantantes. Además, deben enfrentarse al alcalde corrupto y malvado, quien acusa falsamente a una de ellas y hace que termine en la cárcel.

programme.desc: a vibrant festive cooking series celebrating the joy of food, culture, and togetherness during the Deepavali season. From nostalgic village-inspired dishes and irresistible festive treats to cooking for charity and sharing meals in celebrity homes, the series invites viewers to experience the true spirit of Deepavali — where food becomes a bridge that connects families, cultures, and communities.

programme.title: Anbin Aaram
programme.desc: Nilachoru (Moonrice) is an imaginary food that mothers will feed their kids when their young - pointing to the moon and feeding the rice. Saravanan does the same for his sisters as he had been the parent figure in their lives. Every now and then, they will all gather at Sarala's open terrace and have nilachoru' and reminisce their childhood.

programme.title: Seithi
programme.desc: (Live) Tamil Seithi focuses primarily on local and international news, information and current affairs. Catch the online news portal at http://seithi.mediacorp.sg/

programme.title: Ratchagan
programme.desc: After years of being a successful actor, Ram's career has hit a rough patch. He's been struggling to find work and is now on the brink of bankruptcy. Just when he thinks things can't get any worse, he receives news that his estranged father has passed away and left him his barbershop and a fortune that comes with it. However, there's a catch. In order to inherit the fortune, Ram must become the legal guardian of his two step-siblings, whom he hasn't seen before.

programme.title: Thoonga Nagaram
programme.desc: It's late at night... you and your friends are bored and looking for the something exciting to do! Check out Thoonga Nagaram and let them be your guide to after-dark in Singapore!

programme.title: Chutney Sambar
programme.desc: After Sofie's father passed away, the only comfort she found was in Babu's kind words and support. Through Amutha's conversations with him, they developed a strong bond. Meanwhile, Sachien Babu met Jancy's father and learned the truth about his own parents' relationship and the reason behind the rejected marriage proposal. Later, Sofie's ex–mother-in-law and husband confronted her, threatening her to reconcile with him.

programme.title: Vilangu
programme.desc: Vilangu (Handcuff/ Beast) is an inspirational and emotional social drama that entails the journeys of three ex-convicts: Thiyaagaraajan, Sivaprakash and Johnny Janaardhan. Three different men, three different age groups, three different backgrounds, three different social strata and three different crimes. But their paths cross and their lives are intertwined by one common factor: All 3 are former criminals who have been cuffed' for life by society.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 5
programme.desc: A white lion brings mixed fortunes to the family and Rosie is asked the big question. Amy Kriel is the last person you expect in Africa.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 6
programme.desc: Caroline's sister Judith tries to help and the drought forces Danny to sell some of his animals. Will Rosie and Max get married?

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 7
programme.desc: The drought finally throws up a fire and the wedding turns into a firefight for everyone. The omens are bad.

programme.title: Wild At Heart
programme.desc: Tragedy strikes and the Trevanians have to decide what future lies ahead of them in these difficult times.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 1
programme.desc: It's a year since we left Leopard's Den and much has changed. The animal hospital has been rebuilt and is now up and running. It's a big day for all the family as Danny has been fighting for custody of Evan and today they will learn the judge's decision.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 2
programme.desc: Danny and Evan's life on the run doesn't start well when Danny falls asleep at the wheel and drives into a ditch. They have to enlist a local farmer, Johann, to winch them out.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 3
programme.desc: Danny is asked by the State Vet to help control an outbreak of rabies in the National Park. When Vanessa is concerned for the animals at Mara, Danny assures her it's a long way away and advises her to continue with business as usual.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 4
programme.desc: It's the day before Rosie's wedding. Danny is proud of his daughter and determined to feed her up now that she's eating for two. All the family are excited about the imminent return of Caroline, especially Du Plessis who can't wait to see his fiancé.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 5
programme.desc: Alice and Danny are called out by a farmer who's trapped an African Wild Dog. As they're even more endangered than cheetahs and much more vicious, Danny and Alice are amazed to see one up close.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 6
programme.desc: When Du Plessis instructs the family to be around for dinner, they are intrigued to hear he's planning a big announcement. However, he won't be drawn on details and tells them to be patient.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 7
programme.desc: Alice and Danny are delighted when the Animal Hospital is given responsibility for the rescue and conservation of animals in the region – it's a big achievement after all their hard work.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 8
programme.desc: Danny and Alice are concerned about a missing male giraffe but Du Plessis is confident he can find him. He's as good as his word but they're upset to discover Mara lions have killed the giraffe.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 9
programme.desc: The family frantically dig for Charlotte in the rubble, hoping that somehow she has survived. Rowan arrives and takes charge of the situation, directing them to be more methodical in their rescue efforts.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 10
programme.desc: Danny and Alice are enjoying being together but agree to keep their relationship under wraps for the moment. However, they're unaware Georgina has heard their every word!

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 1
programme.desc: Danny and Alice's project to re-habilitate a group of circus elephants has been a huge success but now they have too many elephants on Leopard's Den, so they urgently need to move the circus herd to the National Park.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 2
programme.desc: Leopard's Den is helping to build a new school in the township but when Danny hurts his back he begins to have a crisis about his age. Danny and Alice are surprised when Vanessa comes to them for advice.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 3
programme.desc: Mara is hosting a beauty pageant and Rowan realises he needs all the publicity he can get. He buys a tiger from a zoo and convinces Alice he plans to rehabilitate it. Alice is enjoying working with her brother and even defends him to Danny.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 4
programme.desc: Danny and Alice have been preparing a cheetah for release in the wild but for some reason Danny's mind isn't on the job. He's been pre-occupied because he plans to buy a ring and propose to Alice!

programme.title: Snowmobiler TV
programme.desc: Snowmobiler Television is a show for snowmobilers, from snowmobilers. STV brings you the best riding, wrenching, touring and adventures from the snowmobiling world.

programme.title: Wiebe Trapline Adventures
programme.desc: At just 18, Zac Gidney already has a deep understanding of trapping and animal behavior—knowledge well beyond his years. His mother, Laura, is every bit as skilled. Join this talented duo on their New York trapline as they put their experience to work.

programme.title: Viejo Creek Outdoors
programme.desc: Avery Simpson takes a break from her college studies and gets in some quality time hunting with dad. Plus,....Viejo Creek Marketing Director, Tara Stewart, scores a wild hog with her bow.

programme.title: Guns and Gear
programme.desc: Celebrity hosts Tom and Ryan Gresham highlight a variety of the new firearms, knives and hunting equipment made available to consumers through field demonstrations and interviews with the developers of the anticipated hunting weaponry.

programme.title: DeerTopia
programme.desc: This episode of Deertopia proves that small-property managers can achieve massive habitat success with the right strategy. The team shares expert tips on creating year-round food sources using native fruits and Dunston Chestnuts, navigating the strict margin for error on small acreage, and prepping soil for spring planting. Plus, see the strategy pay off with a thrilling, last-minute harvest of a giant Illinois buck.

programme.title: Argo Presents How To Hunt
programme.desc: Ryan Kohler and Gunther Tondelier head deep into Alberta's timber in search of elk. After days of hard hunting, the duo finishes strong with full freezers.

programme.title: The Canadian Tradition
programme.desc: On this episode, Taylor and Britt share some of their thoughts, struggles and strategies that they have used to introduce their kids to the great outdoors!

programme.title: Savage Outdoors
programme.desc: The show hosts and the pro-staff of The Savage Outdoors capture some of the best big game hunts in North America on film, detailing the full experience of the hunt from start to finish, including strategy and hunting tips.

programme.title: Dean Partridge's Canadian Whitetail
programme.desc: Host Dean Partridge and his team share their passion for hunting whitetail by showing the entire process they go through in order to harvest their targets, from scouting the animal to setting stands and finally taking the shot to complete the trip.

programme.title: The Wild Outdoors
programme.desc: Come along with Jay and Wyatt Gregory as they share The Wild Outdoors!!! A bowhunting series in its 32nd year has something for everyone!!! The Wild Outdoors spotlights fairchase bowhunting across this great country, chasing everything from elk and antelope to turkeys and bear, with an emphasis on big mature whitetails in the Midwest!! Jay, Wyatt and the staff will take you along on hunts just the way they happen, from start to finish!!

programme.title: Bushnell Presents Prairie Pursuit
programme.desc: Weeks into the Saskatchewan whitetail season, Mike Bourque is still chasing one giant buck that refuses to make a mistake. With only days left and temperatures dropping, he gets one final chance to close the deal.

programme.title: CCFR Radio: On the Air
programme.desc: Join Rod Giltaca, from the CCFR, and guests in a firearm-related current events show. This Canadian podcast style show explores topics about firearms and firearm rights!

programme.title: The Edge
programme.desc: Steve faces his final hurdle for the Super North American 29 Grand Slam - the Alaskan Brown Bear. In the rugged Peninsula wilds, he battles brutal weather and apex predators to complete a lifelong quest. Will he capture the legendary 29th species?

programme.title: Higdon Outdoors TV
programme.desc: Higdon Outdoors TV represents the vision of a team of waterfowl hunters, product developers and industry professionals whose goal is to get hunters everywhere fired up. The Higdon Outdoors Team chases waterfowl across North America and delivers some of the most exciting, adrenaline-pumping waterfowl hunting action ever seen on TV.

programme.title: Outdoor Quest TV
programme.desc: T.J. Schwanky and Vanessa Harrop travel around the world on hunting expeditions in hopes of finding trophy-caliber wildlife, discussing the techniques they are implementing to find success and the equipment they are using out in the wild.

programme.title: Argo Presents How To Hunt
programme.desc: Ryan Kohler and Gunther Tondelier head deep into Alberta's timber in search of elk. After days of hard hunting, the duo finishes strong with full freezers.

programme.title: Game On with Blaine Anthony
programme.desc: Blaine finishes up his black buck hunt in Texas then goes after Camp meat. We are officially on doe patrol.

programme.title: Guns and Gear
programme.desc: Celebrity hosts Tom and Ryan Gresham highlight a variety of the new firearms, knives and hunting equipment made available to consumers through field demonstrations and interviews with the developers of the anticipated hunting weaponry.

programme.title: Savage Outdoors
programme.desc: The show hosts and the pro-staff of The Savage Outdoors capture some of the best big game hunts in North America on film, detailing the full experience of the hunt from start to finish, including strategy and hunting tips.

programme.title: Yamaha Whitetail Diaries
programme.desc: This week, we’re back in Texas at our deer lease, which means it’s a home game and it’s all about finding deer on Stealth Cams, playing the wind, and relaxing around camp shooting bows, telling stories, and eating Angel’s home cooking.

programme.title: The Canadian Tradition
programme.desc: On this episode, Taylor and Britt share some of their thoughts, struggles and strategies that they have used to introduce their kids to the great outdoors!

programme.title: Passion for the Hunt
programme.desc: Incredible goose hunting destination. Road trip waterfowl hunting experience to Saskatchewan. Field hunting specks (speckle belly or white front geese) with bonus sandhill cranes.

programme.title: Dean Partridge's Canadian Whitetail
programme.desc: Host Dean Partridge and his team share their passion for hunting whitetail by showing the entire process they go through in order to harvest their targets, from scouting the animal to setting stands and finally taking the shot to complete the trip.

programme.desc: Paid Programming

programme.title: Paid Program

programme.title: 72 Hours to Survive
programme.desc: Dale meets a hunter heading out bowhunting on a day trip (Northern AB Stettler County). Dale heads out in an abandoned coulee area and becomes lost. Dale has 72 hours with what just the hunter had with him in his daypack and clothing: until rescue.

programme.title: DeerTopia
programme.desc: Steve Bartylla debunks the "doe factory" myth, explaining how over-improving land can drive mature bucks out of their bedding areas. Learn how to strategically segregate your property, create low-impact travel "dead zones," and identify which specific does to harvest for better herd management before Steve heads out to a low-impact stand.

programme.title: The Wild Outdoors
programme.desc: Come along with Jay and Wyatt Gregory as they share The Wild Outdoors!!! A bowhunting series in its 32nd year has something for everyone!!! The Wild Outdoors spotlights fairchase bowhunting across this great country, chasing everything from elk and antelope to turkeys and bear, with an emphasis on big mature whitetails in the Midwest!! Jay, Wyatt and the staff will take you along on hunts just the way they happen, from start to finish!!

programme.title: Bushnell Presents Prairie Pursuit
programme.desc: Weeks into the Saskatchewan whitetail season, Mike Bourque is still chasing one giant buck that refuses to make a mistake. With only days left and temperatures dropping, he gets one final chance to close the deal.

programme.title: CCFR Radio: On the Air
programme.desc: Join Rod Giltaca, from the CCFR, and guests in a firearm-related current events show. This Canadian podcast style show explores topics about firearms and firearm rights.

programme.title: The Edge
programme.desc: Steve faces his final hurdle for the Super North American 29 Grand Slam - the Alaskan Brown Bear. In the rugged Peninsula wilds, he battles brutal weather and apex predators to complete a lifelong quest. Will he capture the legendary 29th species?

programme.title: Higdon Outdoors TV
programme.desc: Higdon Outdoors TV represents the vision of a team of waterfowl hunters, product developers and industry professionals whose goal is to get hunters everywhere fired up. The Higdon Outdoors Team chases waterfowl across North America and delivers some of the most exciting, adrenaline-pumping waterfowl hunting action ever seen on TV.

programme.title: Outdoor Quest TV
programme.desc: T.J. Schwanky and Vanessa Harrop travel around the world on hunting expeditions in hopes of finding trophy-caliber wildlife, discussing the techniques they are implementing to find success and the equipment they are using out in the wild.

programme.title: Dirt Nap TV
programme.desc: Host Adam Gotmy has put together a team of pro-staff from all across Canada. The goal of the show is to bring you on the journey of the everyday hunter. All the pro-staff on Dirt Nap TV are your average everyday hunters.

programme.title: High BC
programme.desc: Join us for an unforgettable three-day bear hunt with John Gustafson and Corey Peters as we explore rugged coastal country, glass steep mountainsides, and encounter two incredible black bears.

programme.title: Trigger Time TV
programme.desc: A team of top firearms trainers offer their expertise on a variety of related fields, from concealed carry to home defense, showing the different training regimens to gain experience and their tips on increasing their firearm ability and skills.

programme.title: The Outdoorsman with Max McNeely
programme.desc: Experienced outdoorsman Buck McNeely uses his expertise and passion for the greater outdoors by traveling across the world and inviting celebrity guests to join him as he hunts and fishes for sport, discussing environmental issues and conservation.

programme.title: One After the Other
programme.desc: Eric Lacelle and Eric Marion head out to famous Shannon Lodge just in time to open the fishing season with their well-renowned wall-eye fishing experience.

programme.title: Forever Wild Outdoors Adrenaline Adventures
programme.desc: Today’s emphasis on trophy hunting can be both unrealistic and discouraging to the average hunter. We want to bring the excitement and thrill of the “experience” back to our television viewing audience. High-priced hunts and the constant emphasis on “trophy” hunting have flooded the airwaves.

programme.title: Viejo Creek Outdoors
programme.desc: Keith and Lane spend their Saturday morning doing some whitetail herd management at Viejo Creek Ranch.

programme.title: Huntech Pro TV
programme.desc: In this episode, you'll experience what bushpig hunting is really about - months of preparation, patience, setbacks, family memories, and one unforgettable warrior boar.

programme.title: The One
programme.desc: The One is not about the kill at all. Each episode of The One takes you through an extremely detailed story of what it takes the guys to get to that one opportunity or that one location or even getting the opportunity to take that one animal they have set their sights on. The cast of The One is a unique set of characters that will surely entertain and capture the Outdoor Channel audience. The One is paving the way for the next generation of Outdoor TV on The Outdoor Channel.

programme.title: Hit Squad Outdoors with Tim Sylvia
programme.desc: Join Hit Squad Outdoors as we travel around the world, hunting in a variety of environments. While our mainstay is hunting whitetail deer, we expand beyond our home turf to share hunting adventures from multiple states, pursuing elk, mule deer, and longbeards.

programme.title: The High Road with Keith Warren
programme.desc: On this episode, The High Road travels to the North Island of New Zealand with Wanganui Safaris hunting a variety of species. Keith takes a HUGE fallow buck along with an exotic ram.

programme.title: The Mellon Patch: It's a Family Thing
programme.desc: Beloved teacher Ms. Appleberry and her fellow educators invite preschoolers to explore music, art, and nature. Through catchy songs, gentle lessons, and creative activities, they make early learning an engaging adventure.

programme.title: OnX Game Day
programme.desc: onX Hunt Game Day is a fresh, innovative hunting adventure series that takes viewers beyond the hunt. Featuring multi-species adventures including whitetail big game, upland birds, waterfowl, and fishing, each episode combines action in the field with expert analysis in the studio. Hosted by the onX Hunt team, the series breaks down every hunt, sharing the strategies, mapping tools, and decision-making behind each successful outing. With entertaining host discussions and informative breakdown segments, onX Hunt Game Day delivers an engaging experience that helps hunters of every level become more successful in the field.

programme.title: Claudio Ongaro's Hired to Hunt
programme.desc: On this hunt Claudio guides 5 clients to 30 geese on a challenging hunt where he had to wait for the wind to make the adjustment. It ended well but could have been a lot worse!!

programme.title: Elusive Wildlife Television
programme.desc: We’re bowhunters at heart, but every hunt is different. With hogs feeding in dense cover and limited visibility after dark, this hunt calls for rifles.

programme.title: Bloodline Adventures TV
programme.desc: The crew heads back to Costa Rica, to settle the score with the year before when we got robbed of more than just big fish. This time we are determined to bring in some records!

programme.title: Aventures Express.tv Fishing Edition
programme.desc: Host Mario Huot and his expert team step out of their comfort zones on real-life fishing expeditions, taking on thrilling outdoor challenges in pursuit of memorable catches across remote waters.

programme.title: Red Arrow
programme.desc: Kip heads west with high hopes of an action-packed couple of spot and stalk bow hunts. But what he finds is a less than ideal situation to say the least. You’re not going to believe what the Red Arrow crew has to deal with on this trip.

programme.title: Deer & Deer Hunting TV
programme.desc: This week we dive into whitetail anatomy to explain the science behind a humane harvest. Learn how the mediastinum and thoracic pressure dictate lung collapse after a shot, see how these biological insights pay off during a challenging rut hunt, and get tips on spring food plot preparation.

programme.title: Lands of Nature
programme.desc: In Ecuador, water gives life to an extraordinary world. From winding rivers to dense rainforest, the Amazon reveals a rich ecosystem shaped by water and filled with remarkable wildlife.

programme.title: Snow Trax TV
programme.desc: While traveling across the North American continent, hosts John Massingberd, Jeff Steenbakkers and Debbie Burke present a look at the ins-and-outs of snowmobiling, including new tools, scenic locations, equipment upgrades and responsible riding.

programme.title: Let's Take it Outside with Misty Wells
programme.desc: Hosty Misty Wells travels all around the world in search of the best adventures and travel destinations surrounding her hobbies of fishing and various other outdoor activities, while trying the local cuisines and much more.

programme.title: Dirt Trax Television, Yamaha Grizzly Validation Ride
programme.desc: Dirt Trax TV is the trusted source North American ATV and UTV enthusiasts turn to for Test Ride reviews of todays most popular off-road vehicles. Fans of Dirt Trax TV are also treated to detailed in-shop technical mods and maintenance features along with travel guides showcasing popular off-road destinations.

programme.title: Where Mountains Make Legends
programme.desc: Four men passionate about hunting and fishing travel through the reserves and outfitters of the province of Quebec in order to practice their favorite activities in the company of many guests during fascinating outdoor adventures.

programme.title: Trapping Inc.
programme.desc: Rich and Sandi Mellon show their daily lives as trappers on a registered trapline in Northern Alberta, going over the challenges they are faced with each day as they traverse the nearly 150 square miles of territory that they own for trapping.

programme.title: Non-Typical Nation
programme.desc: Join Brody and Troy as they embark on another exciting trip to Sweetgrass First Nations with Battle River Cree Outdoors. This week, Troy is on the hunt for moose while Brody is after mule deer.

programme.title: Americana Outdoors
programme.desc: The most important information required for outdoor sports and those who enjoy being outside such as safety, weather, stream resources and outfitting needs are explored, featuring the Saltwater Slam and Hunting the Cabela's Trail.

programme.title: Waterfowl East
programme.desc: Matt is met with a challenge to set up in the open with no cover or try and hug a tree line. Wind isn't allowing the tree line hunt so we make the tree line come out of the woods and smack dab in the middle of the field. High risk, great reward.

programme.title: 704 Outdoors
programme.desc: A group of passionate hunters from North Carolina encounter several adventures on their hunting expeditions, right from the state's mountains to the coast.

programme.title: Hunt Warz
programme.desc: We follow four professional cowboys on an unforgettable adventure south of the border. These seasoned cowboys trade their lassos for rifles as they set out to hunt the elusive coues deer during the rutting season in Mexico. Part 1 of 2.

programme.title: Sporting Classics with Chris Dorsey
programme.desc: Chris Dorsey helps showcase some of the most unforgettable hunting and fishing destinations and adventures from around the world, featuring some of the biggest names in the industry and their pursuit for trophy-caliber wildlife at each stop.

In a battle between friends, a fierce match ensues between the two people who know each other’s strategies and cards as they struggle to keep their thoughts of past loyalties at the back of their minds.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Best of Friends Best of Duelists, Part 2
programme.desc: Yugi is shocked as Joey uses the Time Wizard card on him, the very card he gave Joey as a sign of friendship! However, as the two battle each other valiantly and one comes out the victor, they find confirmation of the strength of their friendship that surpasses any duel.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi vs. Pegasus Match of the Millennium, Part 1
programme.desc: Yugi prepares for the ultimate battle against Pegasus with the souls of Grandpa, Kaiba and Mokuba on the line. Meanwhile, Tristan and Bakura infiltrate the castle to find the Kaiba brothers, but at this crucial moment, is Bakura turning back into his evil self again?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi vs. Pegasus Match of the Millennium, Part 2
programme.desc: Pegasus punishes Yugi using the same Toon Deck and mind-reading abilities he used on Kaiba. As Pegasus turns Yugi’s monsters against him, Yugi loses the will to battle. Will Pegasus capture Yugi’s soul into a card, just like Kaiba?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi vs. Pegasus Match of the Millennium, Part 3
programme.desc: Yugi has found a counter to Pegasus’s mind-reading ability: Yugi switches back and forth between his two souls! Yugi is able to destroy Pegasus’s Toon World, but the duel has just only begun. The next level of the deadly Shadow Game is about to start!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi vs. Pegasus Match of the Millennium, Part 4
programme.desc: Yugi crumples in exhaustion under the crippling power of the Shadow Game. His friends yell desperate encouragement, but their voices cannot penetrate the sphere of darkness. Yugi’s chance at victory is slipping away, as is his life!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi vs. Pegasus Match of the Millennium, Part 5
programme.desc: Pegasus summons Relinquished, a fearsome monster that can consume Yugi’s Duel Monsters! Yugi counters with… Kuriboh? The smallest, weakest creature in the game? Has Yugi given up, or does he have one last strategy to snatch victory from the jaws of defeat? The Shadow Game comes to a close!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: The Pegasus Saga comes to an end, but a new journey is about to begin! Yugi meets a mysterious Egyptian named Shadi who enters Yugi’s mind with the Millennium Key. What are these Millennium Items, and do they hold the answer to the mystery behind the Shadow Games?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi and friends return from the Duelist Kingdom only to meet a young girl named Rebecca who demands that Grandpa return Blue-Eyes White Dragon to her! She’s here to claim back the card that Grandpa stole from her grandfather many years ago!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Rebecca mistakenly believes that Grandpa stole Blue-Eyes White Dragon from her grandfather. Yugi must defend Blue-Eyes White Dragon to teach her that it’s not the power of the cards, but the heart that’s in them that counts.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Rebecca mistakenly believes that Grandpa stole Blue-Eyes White Dragon from her grandfather. Yugi must defend Blue-Eyes White Dragon to teach her that it’s not the power of the cards, but the heart that’s in them that counts.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: The two-faced Board of Directors of KaibaCorp trap Kaiba inside a virtual reality game! Mokuba recruits Yugi and Joey to free Kaiba from this ultimate game where losing equals death!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: The quest for Kaiba continues with a little help from… Mai? But can Yugi and friends adapt to a virtual world where the rules and strategies keep changing every step of the way?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi and friends rescue Kaiba, but they are still stuck in the game! The only exit is past Five-Headed Dragon, but in the difficult duel, Joey, Mokuba, and Mai lose all their life points! Can Yugi and Kaiba, two former opponents, work together and face the biggest enemy of their lives?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: A new student, Duke Devlin, defeats Joey in a game of Duel Monsters, forcing Joey to become his servant. Duke forces Joey to wear a dog costume and humiliates him in public, forcing Yugi to challenge Duke to a duel. However, this will not be a Duel Monsters duel, but a new game named Dungeon Dice Monsters!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: In exchange for Joey’s freedom, Yugi agrees to give up Duel Monsters forever if he loses. Unfamiliar with the rules, Yugi gets off to a rough start. His chances do not improve as Duke reveals that he designed Dungeon Dice Monsters with Pegasus’s aid! Can Yugi learn the new complex rules, much less form a strategy, before he is soundly defeated?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi uses his innate gaming skills to turn the tables on Duke, but Duke has one more rule to mention: All creatures take up territory on the grid-like board. With no room to summon any new monsters, Yugi’s position is helpless!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: After Duke’s all-powerful Orgoth the Relentless dices Yugi’s entire cadre of monsters into shreds, Yugi only has one turn left before he loses all his heart points! Yugi’s last hope rests in one final dice roll in the thrilling conclusion to Dungeon Dice Monsters!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: An arcane fortune teller steals the Millennium Puzzle, and Yugi must defeat him in a duel to win it back! However, this is no ordinary soothsayer; he’s a familiar and formidable foe from Duelist Kingdom… or is he? Can Yugi beat him all alone without the help of his friends or the spirit inside the Puzzle?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: The mysterious menace controlling Bandit Keith shatters the Millennium Puzzle into pieces before setting the dueling arena ablaze! Can Yugi put the Millennium Puzzle back together and save the spirit before the entire room is engulfed in flames?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: The origin of Duel Monsters is revealed! Using the magic of the Millennium Necklace, Egyptian historian Ishizu Ishtar shows Kaiba how Duel Monsters was played millenniums ago! The ancient games have resurrected in modern times, along with three almighty beasts of unstoppable devastation – the Egyptian God Monsters!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: The spirit of the Millennium Puzzle realizes that his memories of ancient Egypt have faded, but Téa is going to help him uncover the mysteries of his past! However, their search is interrupted by the dancing duelist Johnny Steps and his musical monsters of rock!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: To face the future, Yugi must first look into the past! Yugi learns that he was a powerful Pharaoh who saved the world five thousand years ago, and he must now save the world again! Meanwhile, Kaiba tests the hidden powers of his Egyptian God Card Obelisk the Tormentor against the fury of Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey is cornered by a group of sinister Rare Hunters who force Joey into a duel where if Joey loses, the Rare Hunters get his precious Red-Eyes B. Dragon! Though Joey pummels his foes with his mighty monster armada, eliminating life points isn’t the only path to victory…

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi vs. Rare Hunter, Part 1: Battle City Begins
programme.desc: It’s time to master new rules and monsters; let the Battle City Tournament commence! In the first duel of the tournament, Yugi challenges the Rare Hunter to win back Joey’s Red-Eyes B. Dragon. However, Yugi’s falling into the same trap that led to Joey’s demise!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi vs. Rare Hunter, Part 2: Up Against Exodia
programme.desc: Yugi figures out the Rare Hunter’s strategy to summon the almighty Exodia, but it’s too late to stop him! The Rare Hunter already has four pieces of Exodia in his hand, and the fifth and final piece is on top of his deck! How can Yugi stop the unstoppable Exodia?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: The psychic duelist Espa Roba defeats Rex Raptor as easy as a chumpasaurus, and Joey’s next on his hit list! What chance does Joey have when Espa Roba has the telepathic ability to read all the cards in Joey’s hand?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey discovers that Espa Roba’s extrasensory perception is a hoax, but he’s not yet free from Espa's mental manipulations! Espa Roba’s Jinzo not only slaughters all of Joey’s monsters, but it grows in power every turn! Joey’s luck has come to an end… or has it?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: The magician duelist Arkana transports Yugi to the world’s most lethal dueling arena where the loser gets sent to the Shadow Realm! Yugi must win this duel or he'll lose much more than his Dark Magician!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: It’s Dark Magician versus Dark Magician! However, while Yugi only controls one Dark Magician, Arkana has three residing in his deck! Though outnumbered, Yugi will never give up, as long as he believes in the heart of the cards!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: To counter Arkana’s Dark Magician, Yugi pulls a rabbit out of his hat: Dark Magician Girl! It’s the battle of the sexes to determine the true master of magicians!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: The trickster Weevil Underwood spins a web of lies to bait Joey into a lopsided duel! Weevil secretly infests Joey’s deck with a parasite that prevents Joey from summoning strong monsters! Without the support of his most powerful beasts, what chance does Joey have against a monster that even Yugi didn’t dare face at Duelist Kingdom: Perfectly Ultimate Great Moth!?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey swats Perfectly Ultimate Great Moth only to have Weevil let loose the ferocious Insect Queen, the crown jewel of insects that grows in strength for every creepy crawler it cannibalizes! Will Weevil’s royal ravager swarm Joey into submission?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi faces off against another of Marik’s nefarious Rare Hunters – the silent but deadly Strings! Strings stops all of Yugi’s attacks with Revival Jam, a slippery slime that resurrects whenever it’s destroyed! How can Yugi win if he can’t even put a dent in Strings’s life points?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Strings summons one of the most powerful creatures in the history of Duel Monsters... the Egyptian God Monster Slifer the Sky Dragon! What chance does Yugi’s band of mortal monsters have against an Egyptian God?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: The spell Infinite Cards allows Strings to hold an unlimited number of cards in his hand, so Strings’s Slifer the Sky Dragon can grow to infinite attack power! Can Yugi discover Slifer’s one fatal flaw before he’s annihilated by tens of thousands of attack points?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey squares off against the sea duelist Mako Tsunami and his bevy of underwater beasts! If Joey wins, he’ll have all six Locator Cards necessary to enter the Battle City Finals, but if he loses, he can kiss the finals goodbye! However, little does Joey realize that he has bigger problems than this duel; the Rare Hunters are closing in on his location…

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Mako’s oceanic warrior The Legendary Fisherman unleashes a wave of destruction by stealthily destroying Joey’s monsters from the depths of the sea! Joey has to put his skills, training and experience to the ultimate test before he’s all washed out!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Double Duel, Part 1: Yugi and Kaiba Vs. Lumis and Umbra
programme.desc: Abductions abound! Marik, with the help of Bakura, kidnaps Joey and Téa! To make matters worse, the Rare Hunters also kidnap Mokuba to force Yugi and Kaiba to take on tag team duelists Umbra and Lumis on top of a skyscraper! The losers will be sent plummeting into the Shadow Realm!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Double Duel, Part 2: Yugi and Kaiba Vs. Lumis and Umbra
programme.desc: Lumis and Umbra systematically dismantle Yugi and Kaiba’s tumultuous teamwork! Can Yugi and Kaiba learn to put their differences aside before they’re sent on a one-way trip into the Shadow Realm?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Furious over Celina's failure at the Friendship Cup, Roget sends a squad of Sector Security to seize her.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yuya’s battle with Crow takes a turn for the worse when Roget takes control of Yuya’s mind!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Crow gets a crash course on double crossing when Yuya pulls a U-turn on their friendship!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: La Saga de Pegaso llega a su fin, ¡pero un nuevo viaje está a punto de comenzar! Yugi se encuentra con un misterioso egipcio llamado Shadi que entra en la mente de Yugi con la Llave del Milenio.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi y sus amigos regresan del Reino de los Duelistas y se encuentran con una joven llamada Rebecca que exige que el abuelo le devuelva el Dragón Blanco de Ojos Azules. Ha venido a recuperar la carta que el abuelo le robó hace muchos años.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Rebecca cree por equivocación que el abuelo le robó el Dragón Blanco de Ojos Azules. Yugi debe defender al Dragón Blanco de Ojos Azules para enseñarle que lo que cuenta no es el poder de las cartas, sino el corazón que hay en ellas.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Con sus engaños, el Consejo de Administración de KaibaCorp atrapa a Kaiba dentro de un juego de realidad virtual. Mokuba recluta a Yugi y Joey para liberar a Kaiba de este juego definitivo en el que perder equivale a morir.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: La búsqueda de Kaiba continúa con un poco de ayuda de... ¿Mai? Pero, ¿podrán Yugi y sus amigos adaptarse a un mundo virtual en el que las reglas y las estrategias cambian a cada paso?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi y sus amigos rescatan a Kaiba, ¡pero siguen atrapados en el juego! La única salida es superar al Dragón de Cinco Cabezas, pero en el difícil duelo, ¡Joey, Mokuba y Mai pierden todos sus puntos de vida!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Monstruos de la mazmorra de los dados: Parte 1
programme.desc: Un nuevo estudiante, Duke Devlin, derrota a Joey en una partida de Duelo de Monstruos, obligando a Joey a convertirse en su sirviente. Duke obliga a Joey a ponerse un disfraz de perro y lo humilla en público, obligando a Yugi a retar a Duke a un duelo.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Monstruos de la mazmorra de los dados: Parte 2
programme.desc: A cambio de la libertad de Joey, Yugi se juega renunciar a los Duelos de Monstruos para siempre. Yugi tiene un comienzo difícil. Todo empeora cuando Duke revela que ha diseñado los Dados Monstruos de la Mazmorra con la ayuda de Pegasus.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Monstruos de la mazmorra de los dados: Parte 3
programme.desc: Yugi utiliza sus habilidades innatas para el juego para dar la vuelta a la tortilla, pero Duke tiene una regla más que mencionar: Todas las criaturas ocupan territorio en el tablero cuadriculado.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Monstruos de la mazmorra de los dados: Parte 4
programme.desc: Después de que el todopoderoso Orgoth el Despiadado de Duke haga trizas a todo el plantel de monstruos de Yugi, a Yugi solo le queda un turno antes de perder todos sus puntos de corazón.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Un adivino misterioso roba el Rompecabezas del Milenio, y Yugi debe derrotarlo en un duelo para recuperarlo. Sin embargo, no se trata de un adivino cualquiera; es un conocido y formidable enemigo del Reino de los Duelistas... ¿o no?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: La misteriosa amenaza que controla a Bandido Keith rompe el Rompecabezas del Milenio en pedazos antes de incendiar la arena de duelos. ¿Podrá Yugi recomponer el Rompecabezas del Milenio y salvar al espíritu antes de que las llaman envuelvan toda la sala?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¡Se revela el origen de Duelo de Monstruos! Utilizando la magia del Collar del Milenio, la historiadora egipcia Ishizu Ishtar muestra a Kaiba cómo se jugaba al Duelo de Monstruos hace milenios.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: El espíritu del Rompecabezas del Milenio ve que han desaparecido sus recuerdos del antiguo Egipto, pero Téa le ayudará a descubrir los misterios de su pasado. El duelista Johnny Steps y sus monstruos musicales del rock interrumpirán su búsqueda.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Para afrontar el futuro, Yugi debe mirar el pasado. Yugi fue un poderoso faraón que salvó al mundo hace cinco milenios. Kaiba pone a prueba los poderes ocultos de su carta egipcia Obelisco el Atormentador contra la furia del Dragón Máximo de Ojos Azules.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Acechado por los Cazadores de Rarezas
programme.desc: Un grupo de siniestros Cazadores de Rarezas acorralan a Joey y le obligan a batirse en duelo. Si Joey pierde, los Cazadores de Rarezas se quedan con su Dragón B. de Ojos Rojos. Joey aplasta a sus enemigos, pero hay otros caminos a la victoria.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi contra el Cazador de Rarezas, Parte 1: Comienza la ciudad de las batallas
programme.desc: Es hora de aprender nuevas reglas y monstruos. ¡Que comience el Torneo de la Ciudad de la Batalla! En el primer duelo del torneo, Yugi desafía al Cazador de Rarezas para recuperar el Dragón B. de Ojos Rojos de Joey.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi contra el Cazador de Rarezas, Parte 2: Contra Exodia
programme.desc: Yugi descubre la estrategia del Cazador de Rarezas para invocar al todopoderoso Exodia, ¡pero es demasiado tarde para detenerlo! El Cazador de Rarezas ya tiene cuatro piezas de Exodia en su mano, y la quinta y última pieza está encima de su mazo.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: El duelista psíquico Espa Roba derrota a Rex Raptor muy fácilmente, ¡y Joey es el siguiente en su lista de objetivos! ¿Qué posibilidades tiene Joey cuando Espa Roba tiene la capacidad telepática de leer todas las cartas del mazo de Joey?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey descubre que la percepción extrasensorial de Espa Roba es un engaño, ¡pero no se ha librado de sus manipulaciones! El Jinzo de Espa Roba mata a todos los monstruos de Joey y aumenta su poder en cada turno. ¿Ha llegado a su fin la suerte de Joey?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: El Maestro de los Magos: Parte 1
programme.desc: Arkana, el mago duelista, transporta a Yugi a la arena de duelo más letal del mundo, donde el perdedor es enviado al Reino de las Sombras. Yugi debe ganar este duelo o perderá mucho más que a su Mago Oscuro.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: El Maestro de los Magos: Parte 2
programme.desc: ¡Es Mago Oscuro contra Mago Oscuro! Sin embargo, mientras Yugi solo controla un Mago Oscuro, Arkana tiene tres en su mazo. Aunque le superan en número, Yugi nunca se rendirá, ¡mientras crea en el corazón de las cartas!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: El Maestro de los Mago: Parte 3
programme.desc: Para contrarrestar al Mago Oscuro de Arkana, Yugi saca un conejo de su chistera: ¡La Maga Oscura! ¡Es la batalla de los sexos para determinar quién es el verdadero maestro de los magos!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: El tramposo Larva Subterráneo teje una red de mentiras para atraer a Joey a un duelo desigual. Larva Subterránea infecta en secreto el mazo de Joey con un parásito que le impide invocar monstruos fuertes.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey aplasta al Gran Moth Definitivo Perfecto, pero Larva suelta a la feroz Reina de los Insectos, la joya de la corona de los insectos que aumenta su fuerza con cada oruga que canibaliza. ¿Conseguirá la reina devoradora de Larva someter a Joey?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi se enfrenta a otro de los nefastos Cazadores de Rarezas de Marik: ¡el silencioso pero mortal Cuerdas! Cuerdas bloquea todos los ataques de Yugi con Gelatina Reanimada, un limo resbaladizo que resucita cada vez que lo destruyen.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Cuerdas convoca a una de las criaturas más poderosas de la historia de Duelo de Monstruos... ¡el dios egipcio Slifer el Dragón del Cielo! ¿Qué posibilidades tiene la banda de monstruos mortales de Yugi contra un dios egipcio?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: El hechizo Cartas Infinitas permite a Cuerdas tener un número ilimitado de cartas en su mazo, ¡así que Slifer el Dragón del Cielo de Cuerdas puede crecer hasta un poder de ataque infinito!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey se enfrenta al duelista del mar Mako Tsunami y su grupo de bestias submarinas. Si Joey gana, tendrá las seis cartas de localización necesarias para entrar en las finales de Ciudad de las Batallas, pero si pierde, ¡tendrá que despedirse dels finales!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¡El guerrero marino de Mako, el Pescador Legendario, desata una ola de destrucción que va destruyendo a los monstruos de Joey! ¡Joey tiene que recurrir a sus habilidades, su entrenamiento y su experiencia antes de que todo se acabe!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Doble duelo. Parte 1: Yugi y Kaiba contra Lumis and Umbra
programme.desc: ¡Los secuestros abundan! Marik, con la ayuda de Bakura, secuestra a Joey y Téa. Además, los Cazadores de Rarezas también secuestran a Mokuba para obligar a Yugi y Kaiba a enfrentarse a los duelistas Umbra y Lumis en lo alto de un rascacielos.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Doble duelo. Parte 2: Yugi y Kaiba contra Lumis and Umbra
programme.desc: Lumis y Umbra destruyen sistemáticamente el caótico trabajo en equipo de Yugi y Kaiba. ¿Podrán Yugi y Kaiba aprender a dejar de lado sus diferencias antes de ser enviados a un viaje sin retorno al Reino de las Sombras?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Doble duelo. Parte 3: Yugi y Kaiba contra Lumis and Umbra
programme.desc: Yugi y Kaiba empiezan a mostrar signos de trabajo en equipo, pero es demasiado poco y demasiado tarde cuando Umbra y Lumis convocan a la Bestia Enmascarada Des Gardius, ¡una monstruosa amenaza aún más poderosa que el Dragón Blanco de Ojos Azules!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Doble duelo. Parte 4: Yugi y Kaiba contra Lumis and Umbra
programme.desc: ¡Yugi combina sus monstruos magnéticos en la potencia polar de Valkyrion el Guerrero Magno! Sin embargo, poco sabe Yugi que Umbra y Lumis tienen una última máscara para volver a los monstruos de Yugi contra él.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi y Kaiba van en misión de rescate para salvar a sus amigos. Pero en el camino, todas sus preocupaciones y secretos se revelan al revivir los problemas que han enfrentado... ¡y que enfrentarán en el futuro!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: El duelo es de amigo contra amigo porque Marik controla mentalmente a Joey para que se bata en duelo contra Yugi. El perdedor será arrastrado al océano. ¿Podrá Yugi liberar a Joey de su hechizo, o será Joey el que acabe con Yugi?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Aunque Joey le ha diezmado sus puntos de vida, Yugi no se atreve a atacar a su querido amigo. Yugi convoca al monstruo favorito de Joey, el Dragón B. de Ojos Rojos, para intentar que Joey recupere la cordura.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi empieza a romper el hechizo de Marik sobre Joey, pero ahora debe batirse en duelo sin el Rompecabezas del Milenio. Cuando Joey roba la carta que necesita para diezmar los puntos de vida de Yugi, ¿qué posibilidades le quedan para ganar?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Solo queda un minuto de duelo para que el perdedor caiga en las profundidades del mar. ¿Se enviarán estos mejores amigos a su perdición? Sin embargo, puede haber una salvadora especial que acaba de recuperar la vista.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Es la batalla de los espectros porque Bakura desata su ejército de fantasmas contra los feroces zombis de Bonz para poder entrar en la final de la Ciudad de la Batalla. Pero, ¿por quién doblará la campana final cuando jueguen en el Reino de las Sombras?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Es un juego de amor porque el rompecorazones de Hollywood, Jean-Claude Magnum, desafía a Mai a un duelo para conseguir su mano. ¿Sucumbirá Mai al encanto de Jean-Claude, por no hablar de su grupo de monstruos ninja?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¡Que comience la final de la Ciudad de la Batalla! Los ocho finalistas pondrán a prueba su habilidad y resistencia en una arena de duelo a miles de metros de altura.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: El espíritu oscuro se revela: Yugi contra Bakura: Parte 1
programme.desc: Es el primer duelo de la final. Yugi se enfrenta al espíritu maligno del Anillo del Milenio que posee a Bakura. Yugi se deshace de los grotescos espectros de Bakura, pero él tiene una estrategia sacada directamente del cementerio…

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: El espíritu oscuro se revela: Yugi contra Bakura: Parte 2
programme.desc: Bakura activa el Tablero del Destino, que hará que Yugi pierda automáticamente en cinco turnos. Por si fuera poco, el Santuario Oscuro de Bakura daña los puntos de vida de Yugi cada vez que ataca! Sin poder atacar y sin tiempo, Yugi está atrapado.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: El espíritu oscuro se revela: Yugi contra Bakura: Parte 3
programme.desc: Slifer el Dragón del Cielo de Yugi está a punto de dar el golpe final para ganar el duelo, pero Bakura podría no sobrevivir a la explosión del todopoderoso monstruo egipcio.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: La furia de los dioses egipcios
programme.desc: ¡Por fin se revela el origen de las cartas de dioses egipcios! El misterioso Shadi lleva a Yugi a un viaje a través del tiempo hasta la creación de Duelo de Monstruos... ¡y los peligrosos poderes que liberó!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: En el segundo duelo de la final, Odion, disfrazado de Marik, desconcierta a Joey con numerosas trampas para llevar el duelo a un punto muerto. Sin embargo, Joey cuenta con la Tornado Gigante, la contrapartida perfecta que garantiza la victoria de Joey.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Las Encarnaciones de Apophis de Odion se ensañan con los monstruos de Joey... ¡y con sus puntos de vida! ¿Podrá Joey utilizar eficazmente los monstruos que ganó antes en el torneo, o está ya demasiado nervioso para montar un contraataque exitoso?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Es un frenesí devorador porque el Serket de Odion devora a los monstruos de Joey para transformarse en poderosas etapas de evolución. ¿Cómo puede Joey derrotar a Serket cuando éste ingiere los monstruos de Joey cada vez que los invoca en el campo?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Odion utiliza una carta de dios egipcio falsa para invocar al tercer monstruo divino egipcio, el Dragón Alado de Ra, y lo utiliza para aniquilar los cinco puntos de vida que le quedan a Joey.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Un juego mental: Mai contra Marik: Parte 1
programme.desc: El tercer duelo de la final de la Ciudad de Batalla entre Mai y Marik no es un duelo normal. Es una batalla en el temido Reino de las Sombras donde perder puntos de vida equivale a perder tus recuerdos.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Un juego mental: Mai contra Marik: Parte 2
programme.desc: A medida que Mai pierde cada vez más recuerdos bajo el implacable asalto de Marik, también pierde la confianza en sus habilidades para combatir en duelos.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Un juego mental: Mai contra Marik: Parte 3
programme.desc: Mai se hace con el control del Dragón Alado de Ra de Marik, pero es incapaz de averiguar cómo desatar sus poderosas habilidades.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Un duelo con el destino: Kaiba contra Ishizu: Parte 1
programme.desc: En el cuarto duelo de la final de la Ciudad de Batalla, la misteriosa oponente de Kaiba es... ¡Ishizu! Con el poder de su Collar del Milenio, Ishizu puede ver el futuro. ¡Incluso todas las cartas que Kaiba tiene previsto jugar!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Un duelo con el destino: Kaiba contra Ishizu: Parte 2
programme.desc: Utilizando la magia de su Collar del Milenio, Ishizu ya ha visto el resultado del duelo: ¡derrotará a Kaiba con su trampa! ¿Cómo puede ganar Kaiba si ya está destinado a perder? Es hora de que Kaiba cambie el futuro.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: El secreto de los guardianes de tumbas
programme.desc: A medida que crece la maldad de Marik, Ishizu revela los secretos de su linaje: ¿Cómo pasó Marik de niño bondadoso a tirano ávido de poder que quiere dominar el mundo? ¿Podrá Yugi salvar a Marik del borde de las tinieblas, o ya es demasiado tarde?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: El enfrentamiento en las sombras: Marik contra Bakura: Parte 1
programme.desc: Con su pacto anterior roto, Bakura se bate en duelo con Marik para conseguir el derecho a controlar la Vara del Milenio y el Anillo del Milenio. ¡El perdedor quedará atrapado en el Reino de las Sombras para siempre!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: El enfrentamiento en las sombras: Marik contra Bakura: Parte 2
programme.desc: Bakura y el Marik bueno invocan al Dragón Alado de Ra, listo para explotar y desterrar al Marik malo al Reino de las Sombras. Pero el Dragón Alado de Ra tiene más de una habilidad especial. ¡Y el malvado Marik sabe utilizarlas todas!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: El dirigible de Kaiba se dirige a la isla de KaibaCorp para las rondas finales del Torneo de la Ciudad de la Batalla. Un niño llamado Noah y sus secuaces secuestran su nave: ¡Cinco enemigos conocidos del pasado de Yugi y Kaiba que buscan venganza!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey decide luchar contra Rex Raptor sin la ayuda de sus amigos para demostrar que es lo suficientemente hombre como para cuidar de Serenity por sí mismo.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey busca frenéticamente la carta que le permite entrar en la batalla final, sin darse cuenta de que Bandido Keith se la ha robado. Mientras intenta aceptar el hecho de que Serenity estará ciega para siempre, recibe la ayuda de un nuevo amigo.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: La baraja Máquina de Bandido Keith obliga a Joey a ponerse a la defensiva. Joey copia la estrategia de Keith para metalizar su Dragón B. de Ojos Rojos. ¿Está asegurada la victoria, o el tramposo Bandido Keith tiene una última carta en la manga?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: La misteriosa amenaza que controla a Bandido Keith rompe el Rompecabezas del Milenio en pedazos antes de incendiar la arena de duelos. ¿Podrá Yugi recomponer el Rompecabezas del Milenio y salvar al espíritu antes de que las llaman envuelvan toda la sala?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¡Se revela el origen de Duelo de Monstruos! Utilizando la magia del Collar del Milenio, la historiadora egipcia Ishizu Ishtar muestra a Kaiba cómo se jugaba al Duelo de Monstruos hace milenios.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: El espíritu del Rompecabezas del Milenio ve que han desaparecido sus recuerdos del antiguo Egipto, pero Téa le ayudará a descubrir los misterios de su pasado. El duelista Johnny Steps y sus monstruos musicales del rock interrumpirán su búsqueda.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Para afrontar el futuro, Yugi debe mirar el pasado. Yugi fue un poderoso faraón que salvó al mundo hace cinco milenios. Kaiba pone a prueba los poderes ocultos de su carta egipcia Obelisco el Atormentador contra la furia del Dragón Máximo de Ojos Azules.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Acechado por los Cazadores de Rarezas
programme.desc: Un grupo de siniestros Cazadores de Rarezas acorralan a Joey y le obligan a batirse en duelo. Si Joey pierde, los Cazadores de Rarezas se quedan con su Dragón B. de Ojos Rojos. Joey aplasta a sus enemigos, pero hay otros caminos a la victoria.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi contra el Cazador de Rarezas, Parte 1: Comienza la ciudad de las batallas
programme.desc: Es hora de aprender nuevas reglas y monstruos. ¡Que comience el Torneo de la Ciudad de la Batalla! En el primer duelo del torneo, Yugi desafía al Cazador de Rarezas para recuperar el Dragón B. de Ojos Rojos de Joey.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi contra el Cazador de Rarezas, Parte 2: Contra Exodia
programme.desc: Yugi descubre la estrategia del Cazador de Rarezas para invocar al todopoderoso Exodia, ¡pero es demasiado tarde para detenerlo! El Cazador de Rarezas ya tiene cuatro piezas de Exodia en su mano, y la quinta y última pieza está encima de su mazo.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: El duelista psíquico Espa Roba derrota a Rex Raptor muy fácilmente, ¡y Joey es el siguiente en su lista de objetivos! ¿Qué posibilidades tiene Joey cuando Espa Roba tiene la capacidad telepática de leer todas las cartas del mazo de Joey?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey descubre que la percepción extrasensorial de Espa Roba es un engaño, ¡pero no se ha librado de sus manipulaciones! El Jinzo de Espa Roba mata a todos los monstruos de Joey y aumenta su poder en cada turno. ¿Ha llegado a su fin la suerte de Joey?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: El Maestro de los Magos: Parte 1
programme.desc: Arkana, el mago duelista, transporta a Yugi a la arena de duelo más letal del mundo, donde el perdedor es enviado al Reino de las Sombras. Yugi debe ganar este duelo o perderá mucho más que a su Mago Oscuro.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: El Maestro de los Magos: Parte 2
programme.desc: ¡Es Mago Oscuro contra Mago Oscuro! Sin embargo, mientras Yugi solo controla un Mago Oscuro, Arkana tiene tres en su mazo. Aunque le superan en número, Yugi nunca se rendirá, ¡mientras crea en el corazón de las cartas!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: El Maestro de los Mago: Parte 3
programme.desc: Para contrarrestar al Mago Oscuro de Arkana, Yugi saca un conejo de su chistera: ¡La Maga Oscura! ¡Es la batalla de los sexos para determinar quién es el verdadero maestro de los magos!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: El tramposo Larva Subterráneo teje una red de mentiras para atraer a Joey a un duelo desigual. Larva Subterránea infecta en secreto el mazo de Joey con un parásito que le impide invocar monstruos fuertes.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey aplasta al Gran Moth Definitivo Perfecto, pero Larva suelta a la feroz Reina de los Insectos, la joya de la corona de los insectos que aumenta su fuerza con cada oruga que canibaliza. ¿Conseguirá la reina devoradora de Larva someter a Joey?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi se enfrenta a otro de los nefastos Cazadores de Rarezas de Marik: ¡el silencioso pero mortal Cuerdas! Cuerdas bloquea todos los ataques de Yugi con Gelatina Reanimada, un limo resbaladizo que resucita cada vez que lo destruyen.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Cuerdas convoca a una de las criaturas más poderosas de la historia de Duelo de Monstruos... ¡el dios egipcio Slifer el Dragón del Cielo! ¿Qué posibilidades tiene la banda de monstruos mortales de Yugi contra un dios egipcio?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: El hechizo Cartas Infinitas permite a Cuerdas tener un número ilimitado de cartas en su mazo, ¡así que Slifer el Dragón del Cielo de Cuerdas puede crecer hasta un poder de ataque infinito!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey se enfrenta al duelista del mar Mako Tsunami y su grupo de bestias submarinas. Si Joey gana, tendrá las seis cartas de localización necesarias para entrar en las finales de Ciudad de las Batallas, pero si pierde, ¡tendrá que despedirse dels finales!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¡El guerrero marino de Mako, el Pescador Legendario, desata una ola de destrucción que va destruyendo a los monstruos de Joey! ¡Joey tiene que recurrir a sus habilidades, su entrenamiento y su experiencia antes de que todo se acabe!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Atrapado y a punto de morir, Joey cree que este duelo no puede empeorar. ¡Pero Marik tiene todas las piezas para invocar al Dragón Alado de Ra! ¿Podrá Joey evitar que Marik invoque la carta del dios egipcio o simplemente la victoria no está en las cartas?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Una vez que Yugi y sus amigos llegan al Reino de los Duelistas, Pegasus anuncia que hay muchos secretos extraños en la isla que harán que su último torneo sea diferente a todos los que han conocido.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Después de derrotar la primera oleada de monstruos de duelo de Larva, Yugi se sorprende al descubrir que Larva tiene un último truco bajo la manga: ¡una voraz Gran Polilla que se vuelve más poderosa con cada turno.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey busca un oponente de duelo al que pueda vencer y acaba aceptando valientemente un reto de la veterana duelista Mai.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Si Yugi es eliminado del torneo, la malvada Junta Directiva de KaibaCorp entregará el control de la compañía a Pegasus.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Si Yugi es eliminado del torneo, la malvada Junta Directiva de KaibaCorp entregará el control de la compañía a Pegasus.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi debe batirse en duelo con un doble mágico de Kaiba creado a partir de la codicia y la sed de poder que Yugi le borró del alma. Yugi tendrá que descubrir una estrategia para sobrevivir al Dragón Blanco de Ojos Azules de Kaiba.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi derrota al Dragón Blanco de Ojos Azules, ¡pero hay dos más esperando en las alas! ¿Llegará el verdadero Kaiba hasta Yugi a tiempo para ayudar a vencer a este imitador?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey decide luchar contra Rex Raptor sin la ayuda de sus amigos para demostrar que es lo suficientemente hombre como para cuidar de Serenity por sí mismo.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Bakura, el compañero de clase de Yugi, poseído por los poderes oscuros de su Anillo del Milenio, atrapa a Yugi y a sus amigos en un Juego de Sombras en el que ellos se convierten en las cartas.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: A pesar de su asombrosa desventaja, Yugi provoca audazmente a PaniK: "Acabaré contigo en tres turnos". ¿Es un farol de Yugi o tiene ventaja en esta batalla de ingenio?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Atrapados en la cueva del laberinto, Yugi y sus amigos encuentran una salida alternativa, pero la puerta está custodiada por los Hermanos Paradox de Pegasus.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
